translation: (Gancao Xiexin Tang.) Li Binhu said: This is when, on the left, right, above, and below the navel, there is qi that is firm and painful like a rampart; it is precisely the disease of the four channels of the Chong, Ren, Foot-Shaoyin, and Foot-Taiyin. Cheng Wuji's commentary considered it as left liver, right lung, above heart, below spleen, but he had not examined that the four viscera also carry pathogenic factors together. Qibo said: The sea has east, west, south, and north, and a person also has four seas to respond to it.
